Architecture review: no ADR required (single-module, reversible, no new dependency, no convention change); no pattern changes.

items.title: Unify session identity across REST, WebSocket and /intel (one session model)
follow_ups: Tier: P0. Evidence: REST uses uuid sessions + InMemorySessionStore; ws.py and /intel/sessions/{run_id}/snapshot use int run_id via SessionService, whose repo calls silently no-op against InMemorySessionStore (snapshot always empty, WS entries never persisted). /api/v1/stream duplicates ws.py. GameService is built but referenced by no router.
Scope: one id type, one store API, one WS endpoint; decide fate of SessionService, GameService and the duplicate in-memory repos.
Depends on: REQ-0003. ADR likely: yes (cross-cutting convention, two viable approaches).

Architecture review: ADR-0002 (docs/adr/0002-single-session-model.md, status proposed) chose Option A: delete SessionService and GameService, keep app/services/repos.py InMemorySessionStore as the single store, port ws.py and /intel snapshot to uuid session ids via the SessionStore Protocol, remove /api/v1/stream, add shared message-submit helper. data/repos.py deferred to REQ-0005; REQ-0012 may delete it only after REQ-0005. Pattern PAT-ARCH-001 proposed.

Spec drafted (6 work packages, WP-1 helper first; WP-5 deletions after WP-3/WP-4). Awaiting human acceptance of ADR-0002 and PAT-ARCH-001 (both proposed) before implementation. Open question for human: dropping WS 'token' event and in-WS 'cancel' until REQ-0007.
inference_service worker sets status=error before writing meta.error; swap the two calls so a WS poll cannot see error without its text (candidate for REQ-0007)

inference_service.enqueue writes status=queued after put_nowait; a fast worker terminal status could be overwritten, leaving the WS waiting until the reply timeout; set queued before put_nowait (candidate for REQ-0007)
ws.py: no prompt length limit on WS (REST has 4096-char cap) (candidate for REQ-0010). Non-JSON frames are now handled (error event, socket stays open) - fixed 2026-10-11.

cleanup candidates for REQ-0012: duplicate router= line in session.py, stale docstring in data/repos.py ("Used by GameService"), repos.py docstring refers to app.types, keys.txt/all_files.txt/corpus.txt are stale snapshots naming removed modules and are tracked
tests: fastapi 0.141 app.routes only lists _IncludedRouter wrappers; route checks walk original_router (tests 11 and 26a); SPEC-0004 wording for those two items is vacuous as written

RESOLVED 2026-10-11 (ws.py now catches malformed frames; spec item 8 wording still describes the old behaviour): Stage-1 verification 2026-10-11 (non-blocking): WP-4h partially met; spec item 8 outer handler closes non-JSON frames with 1011 while WP-4h prose says socket stays open. Amend SPEC-0004 WP-4h/item 8 to match the chosen behaviour or send an error event for JSONDecodeError.

Stage-1 verification 2026-10-11 (non-blocking test gaps): add WS tests for non-dict frame, inference returning None, whitespace-only text, 'Reply not found' path, outer 1011 handler, client_message_id null; add helper test that a falsy client_message_id is not deduped (messages.py:25-29); add route test that exactly 4096 chars is accepted (session.py:173).
Stage-1 verification 2026-10-11: docs/patterns/architecture/PAT-ARCH-001*.md line ~54 still reads 'To be applied by REQ-0004'; update pattern status once the human accepts the implementation.

Stage-1 verification 2026-10-11: store/inference parameters in ws.py (_wait_for_terminal, _find_reply, _handle_user_message) and messages.py:15-17 are untyped; type them with the app.type_defs Protocols. Non-blocking.

Architecture review 2026-10-11: ADR-0003 (docs/adr/0003-sqlite-session-persistence.md, status proposed) chose Option A: stdlib sqlite3 SqliteSessionStore behind the SessionStore Protocol (no new runtime dependency); data/ deleted; database.url honoured in app/main.py. New proposed pattern PAT-ARCH-002. Proposed wording changes to accepted PAT-ARCH-001 and PAT-CODE-001 flagged for human sign-off (not applied). Awaiting human acceptance of ADR-0003, PAT-ARCH-002 and the PAT-ARCH-001/PAT-CODE-001 wording changes.

items.title: Wire the prompt pipeline into inference (DM system prompt, recent-turn history, voice settings)
follow_ups: Tier: P0. Evidence: the worker and WS send only the raw user text to Ollama (OllamaClient.generate wraps it as one user message). prompt_builders.py reads legacy ORM objects (game.campaign, session_run.entries) and its callers are unreachable; settings.prompts.*, app.max_turns, max_field_len and voice_configs/voice_congfigs.json are never read.
Scope: adapt builders to dict-based messages, add a system message and max_turns history window, load voice config, fix the filename typo, and fix prompts.py (from prompting import ...).
Depends on: REQ-0003, REQ-0004. ADR likely: no (existing builders; record a pattern).
Workflow 2026-10-11: restatement logged in docs/requirements/LOG.md (REQ-0006 row); architecture review in progress.

Architecture review 2026-10-11: no ADR (no docs/adr/README.md trigger fires; small, reversible, no new dependency or convention change, no settings key added). Pattern PAT-ARCH-003 (docs/patterns/architecture/PAT-ARCH-003-prompt-pipeline-in-worker.md) created at status proposed; awaiting human acceptance.

Architecture decisions: chat request built by the worker at run time (not at enqueue); new OllamaClient.chat(messages) with generate(prompt) wrapping it; delete ORM-based build_game_chat_prompt/build_game_state_payload/build_turn_summary and app/intelligence/writer.py; keep world_guide.py and quest_guide.py; keep narrator/adjudicator builders untouched (REQ-0008); rename voice_congfigs.json to voice_configs.json; fix prompts.py import.

Open questions for human before/at implementation: (1) accept PAT-ARCH-003 proposed->accepted; (2) settings.prompts.enable_narration/enable_adjudication intentionally left unread (REQ-0008 owns the two-step flow); (3) only prior messages truncated to max_field_len, current user message not truncated; (4) max_turns counts messages not exchanges; (5) no campaign parameter until REQ-0015.

Spec drafted 2026-10-11: docs/specs/SPEC-0006-prompt-pipeline-into-inference.md (status draft; 34 tests T-01..T-34; WP-1..WP-11). Implementation NOT started; awaiting human gates G-1..G-7 (PAT-ARCH-003 acceptance; confirm enable_narration/enable_adjudication stay unread; confirm only prior messages truncated; confirm max_turns counts messages; confirm no campaign parameter until REQ-0015; confirm spec-level choices; do-not-change list).

Spec-writer notes for implementation: WP order differs from architect order (helper updates WP-6 before worker wiring WP-7, else make_stub_service breaks); WP-3 and WP-4 must land together or WP-4 first (writer.py imports build_game_chat_prompt); prompt_builders.py docstring names the deleted builder; _truncate with n<=0 mangles content (only reachable via bad settings, no guard added).

Out of scope confirmed: streaming generate_tokens still sends raw prompt (REQ-0007); narrate.py calls build_narrator_prompt with wrong kwargs and inference.generate which does not exist (REQ-0008); errored/cancelled turns excluded from history by design.

items.title: Real, non-blocking streaming and honest inference health
follow_ups: Tier: P1, needed by the frontend. Evidence: generate_tokens calls sync httpx inside an async generator (blocks the event loop) and emits one 'token'; settings.ollama.stream is unused; the WS path bypasses the FIFO queue so REST and WS can hit Ollama concurrently; cancel cannot stop a running job; model_loaded is hard-coded True.
Scope: Ollama NDJSON streaming via httpx.AsyncClient, one serialized path for REST and WS, cancel mid-stream, real health probe, and a documented WS event protocol (token/done/error/status).
Depends on: REQ-0004, REQ-0006. ADR likely: yes (streaming protocol is a cross-cutting contract with the frontend).

items.title: Make tools actually work: fix narrate, implement roll, port clear, slash-command dispatch
follow_ups: Tier: P1. Evidence (probed): POST /intel/tools/narrate/invoke returns 'Tool narrate error: str object has no attribute get' (args is str, narrate treats it as dict; build_narrator_prompt is called with kwargs it does not accept; inference.generate does not exist on OllamaInferenceService). roll.py is a stub; clear.py uses the legacy (args, session, game, session_run) signature; tool_handler.run_tool/detect_tool are not called from the message flow.

Also: ToolService.invoke holds a global RLock for the whole call (a slow LLM tool blocks all tools); errors come back as 200 text with error always null; /intel/tools/invoke lets the client override service objects through context.
Note: REQ-0002 excluded the roll parser and narrate body; this requirement lifts that exclusion. Depends on: REQ-0004, REQ-0006. ADR likely: no.

items.title: Make the existing dev token real and browser-compatible (auth, WebSocket auth, CORS from settings)
follow_ups: Tier: P1, frontend blocker. Evidence (probed): any Bearer value is accepted (wrong token returned 202); auth.local_dev_token and auth.enable_auth are unused; POST /sessions and all /intel/* are unauthenticated; ws.py has no auth; /api/v1/stream requires an Authorization header, which browsers cannot send on a WebSocket; CORS origins are hard-coded and ignore settings.server.allowed_origins (Origin :3000 gets 400).
Charter guard: dev-level only. No hardening beyond making the existing token and settings honest and usable from a browser.
Depends on: REQ-0004. ADR likely: yes (WS auth approach is a cross-cutting convention).

items.title: Frontend-ready API contract (pydantic v2 schemas, one status vocabulary, session CRUD, error shape)
follow_ups: Tier: P1. Evidence: schemas use pydantic v1 Config/orm_mode/schema_extra and .dict() under pydantic 2.13 (deprecation warnings); schema docs say queued|in_progress|done but the service emits running|completed; MessageListResp is unused; two entry shapes (MessageResp vs SessionEntry); no list/get/delete session endpoints; the 429 queue-full path is dead because the Queue is unbounded; naive datetime.utcnow().
Scope: enum for message status, session list/get/delete, consistent error body, timezone-aware timestamps, committed OpenAPI snapshot test for frontend codegen.
Depends on: REQ-0004. ADR likely: no.

items.title: Startup and config correctness (main.py honors settings, lifespan, loud config errors)

Evidence: main.py hard-codes host/port/log_dir and ignores settings.server/logging/app.seed_sample_data; reload=True is passed with an app object (uvicorn needs an import string, so reload does not work); inference shutdown runs twice (uvicorn lifespan plus manual); @app.on_event is deprecated; get_settings swallows invalid JSON and returns defaults, reads settings.json relative to CWD, and treats every env var as a possible override; get_namespace uses deprecated .dict(); restart.sh uses a bare 'python' and pkill -f uvicorn.
Depends on: none. ADR likely: no.
